text:
marta: heads-up, deploy-bot just flagged a canary p95 regression for release v3.2.0 at 12:03 UTC — saw ~2.1s -> 4.8s on text-gen path. thinking we should decide rollback vs pin.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Canary telemetry breach: p95 latency > 2.5s for 3 consecutive minutes. Canary traffic=5%. Suggested action: auto-rollback to previous stable (v3.1.8). Reason: latency spike (+130%).
sanjay: tagging this — holding auto-rollback for 2 min. VIP customer with ongoing migration on v3.2.0, need manual decision. @marta can you share the quick diff/notes?
marta: quick dump of canary KPIs: `p50=220ms p95=4.8s error_rate=0.2% throughput stable` stacktrace sample attached in threads (log snippet):
```
2026-02-18T12:02:41Z INFO request id=abc123 seq=45 p95=4.8s kernel=matmul_opt
2026-02-18T12:03:02Z WARN fallback to cpu path for shard-7
```

laura: ops-oncall here — looks like fallback to cpu path on one shard created a hot tail. We don't want full rollback if it's single-shard degrad. Any chance we can pin traffic away from the shard (partial rollback) or route VIP traffic to dedicated pool?

phil: we can do a targeted traffic split: shift VIP customers (10% of canary) to v3.1.8 while leaving the rest on v3.2.0. That buys time to triage. I can push a split and a pin.
sanjay: agree with partial split. Execute the pin for the VIP tenant and set the deploy-bot to pause auto-rollback. Who will communicate to support and the customer success lead?
marta: i'll do support comms and update release notes. message i'll send: "We've observed localized latency for v3.2.0 canary on a subset of requests. We've temporarily routed your traffic to v3.1.8 to ensure stability while we investigate. No action required on your side."

ops-oncall: executing commands now: `rbctl traffic-split --from v3.2.0 --to v3.1.8 --selector tenant=vip-corp --percent 100`
ops-oncall: confirm done — VIP traffic pinned to v3.1.8, canary remaining at 5% but without VIP slice.

deploy-bot: [MANUAL PAUSE] Auto-rollback suspended by user action (sanjay). Rollback cooldown=10m.

phil: will update the rollout dashboard and pin the release manifest to keep v3.2.0 from rolling forward for that VIP. Also adding a canary probe to alert if other shards show cpu fallback.
sanjay: good. Marta, please add a short note to release notes and escalate to SEs for VIP comms. Laura, please keep oncall + logs for 30m and we'll reconvene if p95 doesn't recover.
marta: done — release notes line: "v3.2.0: rolled out feature X; partial traffic pin applied for VIP customers due to canary latency; investigating fallback path."

laura: monitoring — p95 for remaining canary trending down to 260ms after pin. keeping watch. :eyes:

sanjay: thanks all. Decision summary for audit: manual partial pin applied for VIP tenant, auto-rollback suppressed, follow-up blameless postmortem if root cause is confirmed. I'll file the postmortem ticket after we stabilize. :thumbsup:
